notes.title: JermSlots Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
This is a pretty small patch addressing issues that were reported within the first week of release.

The following changes have been made:

[h1]Menus[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed typo in controls information - Bitcoins changed to Baldcoins.
[/list]

[h1]Slot Machine[/h1]
[list]
[*] [i][b]BUG FIX:[/b][/i] After betting when having less than three coins the game sets the bet to the max bet (such as having 4 coins, betting 3 then having 1 left sets the bet to 1). This causes that first bet to reward the lower win as if that was the bet. This has now been fixed and the payout should correctly be based on the bet rather than what the max bet would be changed to.
[/list]

[h1]Graphics Options[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a Vsync option in the Advanced graphics menu. By default, Vsync is disabled but can be toggled on by the user. This value writes to the save file and should carry over after closing the game.
[*] On first time run - the game will detect the user’s desktop resolution and use that as the initial resolution (instead of 1920x1080). Hopefully this will fix issues where people with multiple monitors, especially with laptops, were getting strange resolutions on first run.
[/list]

notes.title: Jermaslots Finally Released!
notes.notes:
Hey GAMERS!

The time is now. Jermaslots is now out and available for free for everyone. I am glad that Jerma had a good time streaming it and that people generally enjoyed watching it.

I hope the enjoyment continues as you get to play it now as well.

I will try to keep up on bugs that are posted to the community page and make sure that things run as smoothly as possible.

Thanks again, and Enjoy!

[b]EDIT: Looks like even though I am seeing it marked as "released" on my end, Steam doesn't let it become downloadable until Monday. Sorry about that guys![/b]

[b]EDIT 2: Still looks like the button is missing for a lot of people. I have a support ticket waiting but no one has looked at it yet. This method works to get the game installed via the Steam Client as if you had the download/install button:

steam://install/1032520

I believe you can put that in RUN via the windows menu or even a web/file browser.

Sorry for the inconvenience but unfortunately all I can do is wait for a response from Valve at this point.[/b]

[b]EDIT 3: Things should now be resolved![/b]

notes.title: Getting So Close
notes.notes:
Not a whole lot to update but we are getting very close to finishing off the last bits of the game.

All of the core game play is complete and testing is continuing to try to find and iron out as many bugs as possible. 

A bit more art is still being worked on and finished up before the Byeah mini-game is finished but other than that, we are nearing the finish line. That being said, I can't give a good estimate on when all of that will be done but I am hoping soon. 

Without giving much away, here is what to expect in the initial release:
[list]
[*] The slot machine, of course, with 6 different winning combinations
[*] Three cut scene type events
[*] Four mini-game events
[*] Many Jerma references / jokes. Some a bit more subtle (COMPACT?) than others
[*] 14 Achievements. If you earn all 14, you will have seen all of the major events and mini games
[*] Not paying a dime - the game is and always will be completely free.
[*] An Easter egg somewhere in the game
[*] Completely new and custom art, models, and textures made from scratch
[*] Jerma's face plastered all over the place
[/list]

I really hope to get this out soon and hope that you all get some enjoyment out of it!

notes.title: Lower Settings / Optimization News!
notes.notes:
Hey GAMERS,

Some good news - I went through and added advanced graphics options to the game that you will be able to find in the options menu under "advanced". This should help fine-tune the game to run on all sorts of machines - old and new. For instance, my wife's grandma laptop (Toshiba Satellite l855-s5366) was able to run the game at 45+ FPS with reduced settings.

While it may look less than pretty for some of the lower end systems, it should run alright.

Oddly enough, my gaming laptop started having new issues with it but that has been an isolated problem that I am still working out - hopefully it doesn't plague anyone else and there's just something wrong with my laptop.

Also, upon first running the game and detecting a save file does not exist (which is created automatically), a benchmark will run and set the graphics options accordingly. You can still change this after the benchmark and your changes will be saved.

notes.title: Initial System Requirements Tests and Distribution
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

I was able to successfully get an alpha build up on Steam for testing across several different computers of different makes/models via Steam distribution.

The good news is that the game was able to be downloaded and installed on all devices tested and the game launched as well through Steam.

The bad news is that it didn't perform [i]that great[/i] on laptops that were 5-6+ years old. 

With the current devices tested, here's a list of the system specs of the lowest end device that ran the game without any frame rate problems:

[list]
[*] OS: Windows 7 Pro 64 Bit
[*] Processor: Intel i5-3570K @3.40 GHz
[*] Memory: 16 GB RAM (Less than 2 GB was used by the game during run-time)
[*] Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 Ti
[*] DirectX: Version 11
[*] Storage: 2048 MB available space
[*] Sound Card: On Board Sound
[/list]

I doubt that something with that high of requirements will be needed for the game but at the moment, that's what I have been able to test for. 

Something else to note - Unreal Editor 4 has baseline requirements for the engine so these may work just fine as well:

[list]
[*] OS: Windows 7 64 Bit
[*] Processor: Quad Core Intel or AMD Processor, 2.5 GHz or Faster
[*] Memory: 8 GB RAM
[*] Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD series card or higher
[*] DirectX: Version 10
[*] Storage: 2048 MB available space
[*] Sound Card: On Board Sound
[/list]

I will keep the system requirements updated with any tests that have lower requirements than listed and work more on optimization to hopefully get the game playable on older / less beefy devices.

notes.title: We're on the store!
notes.notes:
The initial phases have been completed on getting JermaSlots on the steam store. There's still more work to do before it will be ready for release but this was a big step that I was hoping to accomplish so that it will be easy for everyone to get and (hopefully) enjoy!

Also, thanks to the Jerma community - specifically the discord - for the support and patience for all the months I have been working on the game. I hope it will be worth the wait!
